# LAB_CA

The lab's own root: where its certificate and key are on the host, and where it lands in a cluster.

<!-- Generated by nix build .#referencePages -->

Canonically `labCa`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.labCa`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.

| --- | --- |
| caCert | string |
| pem | string |
| secret | record { name, namespace } |
